name: Agent work queue
blurb: A dependency-aware issue queue for coding agents, in the style of beads: file work, link what waits on what, claim what is ready, close it.
about: The agent work queue is a dependency-aware issue tracker for coding agents, in the style of beads. Agents file work, link what waits on what, ask for ready work, claim it and close it. Readiness is worked out on every read, claims are atomic, and the commit history is the audit trail. It is for teams running several coding agents on one codebase.
